prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
ai_overview_text:
The best AI video generator for ads depends on your marketing style, with Creatify leading for e-commerce URL-to-video ads and HeyGen topping avatar-driven localized campaigns. Creatify.ai +1
Best for E-commerce: Creatify turns a simple product page URL into a complete video ad, supporting batch creation, avatar styles, and built-in A/B testing variations. HeyGen +1
Best for Avatar & Multilingual Ads: HeyGen features realistic digital avatars and instant localization across more than 175 languages, making it ideal for global or spokesperson-led campaigns. HeyGen +1
Best for UGC-Style Ads: Arcads offers over 300 built-in AI actors designed specifically for direct-response, user-generated content (UGC) marketing style ads. HeyGen
Best for Cinematic Visuals: Runway (Gen-3/Gen-4) delivers unmatched visual fidelity and advanced camera controls for high-end, futuristic, or cinematic brand commercials. Reddit·r/generativeAI +1
Best All-in-One Creator: InVideo AI converts simple text prompts into ready-to-publish social media video ads with automated scripts, voiceovers, and stock media assembly. invideo AI +1
